conversation.text: You've reached Telecom Haiku customer service. For technical support, press 1. For billing, press 2. For sales, press 3.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Hi, thanks for calling. This is Daniel with technical support. How can I help you today?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: My modem just stopped working completely. The lights went off and now nothing.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Okay, it sounds like the device might be failing. Let me figure out the best solution.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: When did you last reboot it? Sometimes a factory reset helps.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Can you try a different power outlet? Sometimes that solves the problem.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: You're still under warranty. We'll replace it at no cost.
